title: Jumbo Sweet Russian Marshmallows Pudding
description: A sweet and cozy Russian dessert featuring miniature marshmallows, this pudding is perfect for cold winter nights. It is made with kombu cold extract and served in a beautiful lacquerware bowl.
instructions: Combine the milk, sugar, and salt in a medium saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and a splash of the hot milk mixture until smooth.
Add the cornstarch mixture back into the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the unsalted butter and vanilla extract until the butter has melted.
Add the miniature marshmallows to the saucepan and stir until they are fully coated in the pudding mixture.
Stir in the kombu cold extract.
Pour the pudding mixture into a beautiful lacquerware bowl.
Let the pudding cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate until chilled.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with additional miniature marshmallows if desired.
